{{Quote|What's that? It's blowing up from the inside.''"<br />"''We didn't hit it.|Dineé Ellberger and Ric Olié, watching the Droid Control Ship explode over Naboo|audio=ObviouslyDidntHitIt-TPM.flac|<ref name="Episode I" />}}
'''Dineé Ellberger''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She was a troubleshooter of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] systems for years, which gave her substantial technical experience. Later, she became a member of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], and served as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], Naboo, in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Ellberger held the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and was part of [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]] as [[Bravo Five/Legends|Bravo Five]]. She flew an [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]] called ''[[Bravo 5]]'', which had excellent maneuvering capabilities.

Ellberger accompanied the other [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of Bravo [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] when [[Bravo Leader/Legends|Bravo Leader]] [[Ric Olié/Legends|Ric Olié]] called for all N-1 [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|attack]] the [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|droid control ship]] that was controlling the Trade Federation's [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|invasion army]]. During the assault, the weapons on the Naboo pilots' N-1 starfighters weapon systems could not penetrate the control [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], but a [[Youngling/Legends|young boy]] named [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] flew an N-1 starfighter into the ship's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] and fired [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] into the ship's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]]. As Skywalker emerged from the ship, Ellberger noticed that the vessel was exploding from the inside. She informed Olié of this, inducing the surviving pilots to celebrate their victory while they returned to the surface of Naboo.

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|Ric Olié|Fighters straight ahead!|Arven Wendik|Roger, Bravo Leader.|Dineé Ellberger|Roger, Bravo Leader.|attr=Ric Olié, Arven Wendik, and Dineé Ellberger, during the battle against the Droid Control Ship over Naboo|audio=ObviousFighters-TPM.flac|src=<ref name="Episode I" />}}
[[File:Ellberger.jpg|thumb|left|Ellberger during the space battle above Naboo]]
Dineé<ref name="Finest">{{InsiderCite|145|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Naboo's Finest!}}</ref> Ellberger was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Ellberger Databank" /> who lived during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Episode I" /> Her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and her first career was as a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] systems troubleshooter.<ref name="Ellberger Databank" /> Despite some unpleasant experiences during that period of her life, she gained considerable technical experience.<ref name="Officer Ellberger card">{{CCG|set=Theed Palace Limited|cardname=Officer Ellberger}}</ref> Later Ellberger became a part of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]].<ref name="Episode I" /> By the year [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="TCSWEdate">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' places the Invasion of Naboo at 32 BBY.</ref> she had enough piloting experience to fly one of the Royal Naboo's [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]].<ref name="EIVD pilots">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]'' states that anyone who flies an N-1 starfighter has to have experience controlling lesser craft.</ref> That year, Ellberger served as a member of [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]], also known as Bravo Flight, under the leadership of [[Bravo Leader/Legends|Bravo Leader]] [[Ric Olié/Legends|Ric Olié]]. She flew in the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Bravo Five/Legends|Bravo Five]]<ref name="Episode I" /> and piloted a maneuverable N-1 [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] of the [[Bravo 5|same name]].<ref name="Bravo 5">{{CCG|set=Theed Palace Limited|cardname=Bravo 5}}</ref> During her time with Bravo Squadron, Ellberger was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]],<ref name="Officer Ellberger card" /> holding the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]].<ref name="Finest" /> Her fellow pilots did not discuss her unpleasant past.<ref name="Officer Ellberger card" />

In 32 BBY,<ref name="TCSWEdate" /> the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide megacorporation known as the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockaded Naboo]] due to the Republic's taxation of various [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] and the influence of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]], a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. During the blockade, the Trade Federation dispatched its [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] to take control of the world. After Naboo's [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] returned from the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where she had failed to receive aid from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] against the invasion, a plan was made to defeat the [[Battle droid/Legends|droid]] [[Army/Legends|army]]. A key part of the strategy involved destroying the Trade Federation's [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|droid control ship]] that was in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] over the planet.<ref name="Episode I" /> When Ric Olié ordered Naboo's N-1 starfighters to [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|converge]] on the control [[Starship/Legends|ship]],<ref name="Ric Olié Message">{{CCG|set=Theed Palace Limited|cardname=It's On Automatic Pilot!}}</ref> Ellberger joined her fellow pilots as part of the attack force. As she and Bravo Squadron approached the control ship, a large number of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] poured out of it and attacked the Naboo pilots.<ref name="Episode I" /> During the ensuing battle, Ellberger used her technical knowledge to foresee and counteract the [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]]' tactics<ref name="Officer Ellberger card" /> in order to aid the squadron.<ref name="Ellberger Databank" />

In the early stages of the attack on the droid control ship, Olié informed the squadron that the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] on the Trade Federation vessel were too strong for their starfighter weapons to penetrate.<ref name="Episode I" /> Nevertheless, [[Rhys Dallows]], who flew as [[Bravo Ten]], destroyed the droid control ship's [[receiver dish station]]s needed to launch additional droid starfighters. Meanwhile, Ellberger helped protect him from the control ship's droid starfighters.<ref name="Starfighter">[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]</ref> Unbeknownst to Ellberger and the squadron, an N-1 starfighter flown by a [[Youngling/Legends|boy]] named [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered the battle and flew into one of the control ship's [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]]. Skywalker fired [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] into the ship's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]], which caused the ship to explode from the inside. Ellberger noticed these explosions and reported them to Olié as Skywalker flew his fighter out of the hangar. The Naboo pilots celebrated their victory, and the surviving members of the squadron flew back to Naboo while the droid control ship's destruction deactivated the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] army it controlled. With their army neutralized, the Trade Federation's occupation of Naboo was at an end.<ref name="Episode I" />

==Personality and traits==
Ellberger was a skilled computer systems troubleshooter<ref name="Ellberger Databank" /> and pilot<ref name="Episode I" /> who had some experience<ref name="EIVD pilots" /> by 32 BBY.<ref name="TCSWEdate" /> When flying her N-1 starfighter, she was able use the ship's excellent maneuverability to stay a threat to a ship she was targeting.<ref name="Bravo 5" /> During the battle over Naboo, Ellberger's technical experience allowed her to help Bravo Squadron counteract the battle strategies of the droid starfighters.<ref name="Ellberger Databank" /> She had a sour past that her squadmates did not speak about.<ref name="Officer Ellberger card" /> Ellberger had [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], fair skin, and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="Insider's Guide" />

==Equipment==
Ellberger flew ''Bravo 5'', an N-1 starfighter<ref name="Episode I" /> with good evasion capabilities<ref name="Bravo 5" /> as part of Bravo Squadron.<ref name="Episode I" /> ''Bravo 5''{{'s}} maneuverability aided Ellberger in tenaciously opposing her targets.<ref name="Bravo 5" /> She possessed a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] as her personal weapon.<ref name="Ellberger Databank" /> As a pilot in the Royal Naboo Space Fighter Corps, Ellberger wore the standard [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]] of the pilots in Bravo Squadron during the time of the Invasion of Naboo.<ref name="Episode I" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I was up for the part of Darth Vader's mother in the new Star Wars films but I didn't get it, which I was upset about! But they offered me the part of a fighter pilot instead.|Celia Imrie in an interview about her role as Dineé Ellberger|<ref name="Celia Imrie interview">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/episode1/oldpreq/cast/imrie.html|text=Celia Imrie|date=1997-12-18|work=TheForce.Net|archivedate=20161106150230}}</ref>}}
[[File:EllbergerCeliaImrie.jpg|thumb|right|240px|Celia Imrie as Ellberger]]
Dineé Ellberger was portrayed by [[Wikipedia:British people|British]] actress [[Celia Imrie]] in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], a [[1999]] film written and directed by [[George Lucas]]. In the credits at the end of the film, Imrie is listed as playing "Fighter Pilot Bravo 5,"<ref name="Episode I" /> who was later named Ellberger.<ref name="Officer Ellberger card" /> The uniforms created for the Naboo pilots, including Imrie's character, were originally sketched by artist [[Iain McCaig]], who based them on [[Wikipedia:World War I|World War I]] flying uniforms.<ref name="Ric Olié Databank">{{DB|character|ricolie|Olié, Ric}}</ref> Imrie auditioned for the role of [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]], but when [[Pernilla August]] was chosen for the role, Imrie received the role of Bravo 5 instead.<ref name="Celia Imrie interview" />

In the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization of ''The Phantom Menace'']], a female pilot entered an N-1 starfighter that Anakin Skywalker was hiding behind while the Naboo pilots were boarding the fighters in Theed's hangar. The pilot told Skywalker that he would have to find a new hiding place before she flew her fighter away with the rest of the squadron. However, there was no official confirmation that the character was Ellberger. Also, in the novel, Ellberger's line about the droid control ship blowing up from the inside was spoken by [[Bravo Two/Legends|Bravo Two]].<ref name="Episode I Novel">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref>

Her line about the droid control ship blowing up from the inside was featured in ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]'', a [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWBFN">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''</ref> In [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']], a [[2001]] video game by LucasArts, she was one of the pilots covering Rhys Dallows, who was controlled by the player, as Dallows attacked the receiver dish stations in a level involving the attack on the droid control ship. A possible line of dialogue from the game was a pilot saying, "Bravo Five, you have one on your tail," indicating that Ellberger was one of the pilots present in that battle.<ref name="Starfighter" /> 

Also in 2001, Ellberger first received her last name in ''[[Theed Palace Limited]]'' the eleventh and final expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] released by [[Decipher]] The image used on her card was a reversed version of a shot of her from ''The Phantom Menace''.<ref name="Officer Ellberger card" /> In [[2013]], Ellberger received the first name of "Dineé" in [[Rogues Gallery (department)|''Rogues Gallery: Naboo's Finest!'']], which was featured in ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' [[Star Wars Insider 145|145]].<ref name="Finest" />
